concepts.name: JavaScript variable
concepts.description: A named reference to a value in JavaScript code.

concepts.name: let
concepts.description: A JavaScript keyword for declaring a block-scoped variable that can be reassigned.

concepts.name: const
concepts.description: A JavaScript keyword for declaring a block-scoped variable binding that cannot be reassigned.

concepts.name: Primitive type
concepts.description: A basic JavaScript value type such as string, number, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, or bigint.

concepts.name: Expression
concepts.description: Code that evaluates to a value, such as a calculation, variable reference, or function call.

concepts.name: Operator
concepts.description: A symbol or keyword that performs an operation on values, such as arithmetic, comparison, or logic.

concepts.name: if statement
concepts.description: A JavaScript control-flow statement that runs code when a condition is true.

concepts.name: for loop
concepts.description: A loop that repeats once for each item in a sequence or iterable.

concepts.name: while loop
concepts.description: A loop that repeats as long as its condition remains true.

concepts.name: Array iteration
concepts.description: Processing each item in an array using a loop or array method.

concepts.name: Control flow
concepts.description: The order and branching path through which code executes.

concepts.name: Loop termination
concepts.description: The condition or event that causes a loop to stop running.

concepts.name: DOM
concepts.description: The browser’s object representation of an HTML document that JavaScript can read and modify.

concepts.name: querySelector
concepts.description: A DOM method that returns the first element matching a CSS selector.

concepts.name: Event listener
concepts.description: A function registered to run when a specific event occurs.

concepts.name: Click event
concepts.description: A browser event fired when a user clicks or activates an element.

concepts.name: Element state
concepts.description: The current data, attributes, classes, or properties associated with a DOM element.

concepts.name: DOM update
concepts.description: A change to the document object model that affects page structure, content, or attributes.

concepts.name: Promise
concepts.description: A JavaScript object representing an asynchronous operation that may complete successfully or fail later.

concepts.name: async/await
concepts.description: JavaScript syntax for writing asynchronous code in a style that reads like sequential steps.

concepts.name: fetch()
concepts.description: A browser API for making network requests and receiving responses.

concepts.name: API request
concepts.description: A request sent to an application programming interface to retrieve or change data.

concepts.name: JSON
concepts.description: A text data format commonly used to exchange structured data between web clients and servers.

concepts.name: Asynchronous callback
concepts.description: A function that runs later after an asynchronous operation or event completes.
